payload.explanation: Only fixtures/phase2-v2/patch-retry-policy/src/retryPolicy.js was changed (git diff: 7 insertions, 6 deletions); all 4 public tests pass. The patch correctly fixes every seeded defect: digit-only regex /^[0-9]+$/ rejects signed/fractional/exponent/hex/empty and non-strings return null; HTTP-date path guards finite nowMs and returns max(0, dateMs-nowMs); attempt uses Number.isInteger with >=1 to reject 0/negatives/non-integers/Infinity; nowMs finiteness enforced; Retry-After overrides backoff; fallback is 1000*2^(attempt-1) capped at 300000; very large attempts yield 2**n=Infinity clamped by Math.min to a finite 300000. Public API unchanged, Node built-ins only, minimal and clear.
concerns: Digit-only branch does not cap huge delta-seconds internally but computeRetryDelay applies the 300000 cap; parseRetryAfter itself can return an uncapped large value, which matches the contract (cap is specified on returned delay, not on parse), so this is acceptable.
Edge cases like leading zeros ('007') are accepted as valid digits, consistent with 'only ASCII decimal digits' wording.
